gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+13.9% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +13.9%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.6 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.6 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Bloom Energy Corporation on behalf of investors who purchased securities between February 27, 2025 and July 8, 2026. Investors who purchased during this period may be eligible for compensation.

top.title: Bekaert: Update on the Share Buyback Program and the Liquidity Agreement
top.summary: Bekaert repurchased 50,500 shares during the week of 30 July to 5 August 2026 under its €75 million buyback program announced in February 2026, at an average price of €39.40 per share. Additionally, under its liquidity agreement with Kepler Cheuvreux, the company bought 4,996 shares and sold 2,400 shares. As of 5 August 2026, Bekaert holds 1,927,686 own shares representing 3.85% of outstanding shares.

top.summary: Bekaert announced the completion of its share buyback program for the period of July 30 to August 5, 2026, purchasing 50,500 shares at an average price of €39.40 per share for a total of €1,989,715. Under its liquidity agreement with Kepler Cheuvreux, the company bought 4,996 shares and sold 2,400 shares during the same period. As of August 5, 2026, Bekaert holds 1,927,686 treasury shares, representing 3.85% of total outstanding shares.

top.title: BRCB 10-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. Facing Securities Class Action Related to IPO Disclosures Regarding Adverse Impact of Sales Transfer Phenomenon – Hagens Berman
top.summary: Black Rock Coffee Bar, Inc. (NASDAQ: BRCB) is facing a securities class action lawsuit alleging the company made false and misleading statements about its expansion strategy during its September 2025 IPO. The complaint claims management concealed significant 'sales transfer' (cannibalization) issues caused by aggressive store density expansion, which eroded same-store sales growth. The stock has declined over 61% from its IPO price to $7.72 as of June 2026. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 17, 2026.

The lawsuit alleges that Peabody Energy provided misleading statements about its Centurion mine operations, with actual Q1 2026 output reaching only 250,000 tons versus previously estimated 700,000 tons. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 24, 2026. Similar class actions are also being pursued against ADMA Biologics and Microvast Holdings.

(NASDAQ: PHH, BYAH) for the period between December 27, 2024 and July 8, 2025. gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+9.2% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +9.2%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +4.8 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +4.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: ثقة وقوة راسختان في تصنيع FREELANDER 8
top.summary: FREELANDER, a British luxury smart vehicle brand developed by Chery and Jaguar Land Rover, has launched mass production of the FREELANDER 8 at its Changshu Super Factory in China. The facility, backed by over $3.1 billion in investments, features 1,100+ intelligent robots and advanced manufacturing technologies including 100% automation in welding, achieving 0.1mm tolerance precision. The company is preparing for Middle East market expansion with comprehensive quality testing protocols and sustainability measures including 95% air recycling and 0.35 tons of carbon emissions per vehicle.

top.title: Built for Confidence: The Manufacturing Strength Behind FREELANDER 8

top.summary: The global silanes market is projected to grow from USD 3.57 billion in 2025 to USD 6.53 billion by 2035, with a CAGR of 6.23%. Growth is driven by increased demand in semiconductors, electric vehicles, solar cells, and construction. Mono/chloro silanes dominate with 68% market share, while functional silanes represent the fastest-growing segment. Asia Pacific leads with 47% market share, followed by North America and Europe.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +1.8 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +1.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Software-Defined Vehicle Market to Reach $1.70 Trillion by 2035, Driven by Centralized Computing, AI and OTA Updates - Insights by SDV Type, E/E Architecture, Vehicle Type, Offering, Application, and Region
top.summary: The global software-defined vehicle (SDV) market is projected to grow from $447.55 billion in 2026 to $1.70 trillion by 2035, with a 16% CAGR. Growth is driven by centralized computing architectures, over-the-air updates, AI-enabled functions, and feature-on-demand subscription services. Hardware remains the largest offering segment, while North America leads adoption through OEM software investments.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+1.5 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+1.5 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: ROSEN, NATIONAL TRIAL LAWYERS, Encourages Rackspace Technology, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - RXT
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against Rackspace Technology, Hertz Global Holdings, and GPGI, Inc. (formerly CompoSecure). The lawsuits allege that defendants made false or misleading statements regarding their business operations and financial prospects. Investors who purchased securities during specified class periods are encouraged to secure legal counsel before the September 28, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline.

top.title: ROSEN, A GLOBAL AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - HTZ
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is urging investors who purchased Hertz Global Holdings common stock between May 7, 2026 and June 23, 2026 to join a securities class action lawsuit before the September 22, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline. The lawsuit alleges that Hertz made materially false and misleading statements regarding its liquidity position, mischaracterizing market softness as transitory when it was actually recurring and materially depressing financial metrics, and that the company would need to undertake a dilutive, distressed capital raise.

top.title: Did You Incur Significant Losses From Your Investment in Hertz Global Holdings, Inc.? Robbins LLP Encourages Investors to Reach Out for Information About Their Rights
top.summary: Robbins LLP has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Hertz Global Holdings (NASDAQ: HTZ) on behalf of investors who purchased stock between February 28, 2024 and February 25, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Hertz made materially false statements about its liquidity position and financial condition, failing to disclose deteriorating liquidity and recurring softness in the used-car market. The stock declined over 40% on June 24, 2026, when Hertz announced a massive dilutive capital raise and disclosed unexpected losses in the used-car market. The deadline to seek appointment as lead plaintiff is September 22, 2026.

reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)
reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (385) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（385）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +1.5 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +1.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The company declared a $0.05 quarterly dividend.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -10.0 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -10.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Law firm Bragar Eagel & Squire is investigating Myriad Genetics for potential securities violations following the company's disappointing Q2 2026 earnings report. Myriad reported revenue of $190.7 million, down 11% year-over-year and significantly below consensus estimates. The company slashed full-year 2026 revenue guidance from $860-$880 million to $770-$790 million and suspended EBITDA guidance, citing reimbursement pressure, collection issues, and weak prenatal performance. vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: puts modestly richer than calls (-1.0 vol pts vs peers) — mild downside hedge
reasons.zh: 看跌略贵于看涨（-1.0 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和下行对冲

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. top.title: ERASCA DEADLINE: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Erasca, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important August 10 Deadline in Securities Class Action – ERAS
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Erasca, Inc. and its executives for allegedly making false and misleading statements about its lead oncology drug candidate ERAS-0015. The company is accused of improperly comparing its drug to a competitor's candidate and failing to disclose patent and trade secret disputes. Investors who purchased Erasca stock between January 14, 2025 and April 26, 2026 must act by August 10, 2026 to serve as lead plaintiff.

top.title: ERASCA LEAD PLAINTIFF DEADLINE AUGUST 10th: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Reminds Erasca, Inc. (ERAS) Investors with Large Losses to Contact the Firm Regarding their Rights
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Erasca, Inc. alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its ERAS-0015 drug candidate. The lawsuit claims the preclinical data was based on improper comparisons and lacked reasonable basis. Following a patent infringement allegation from Revolution Medicines disclosed on April 28, 2026, Erasca's stock price declined approximately 48% from $19.15 to $9.90 per share. Investors have until August 10, 2026 to apply as lead plaintiff.

top.title: ERAS 3-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Erasca, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit– Hagens Berman
top.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating securities fraud claims against Erasca, Inc. for allegedly misleading investors about its lead oncology drug ERAS-0015's competitive advantages, safety profile, and intellectual property protections. The company faces patent infringement allegations from Revolution Medicines and reported a patient death in clinical trials, triggering a $2.8 billion market capitalization loss. Investors with substantial losses can serve as lead plaintiffs with an August 10, 2026 deadline.

top.summary: Nathan's Famous reported first quarter fiscal 2027 revenues of $54.1 million, up 15% year-over-year, driven by strong growth in the Branded Product Program and licensing royalties. However, net income declined slightly to $8.8 million from $8.9 million due to a 22% increase in beef costs. The company remains on track for completion of its $450 million acquisition by Smithfield Foods at $102 per share in the second half of 2026.

top.summary: The global silanes market is projected to grow from USD 3.57 billion in 2025 to USD 6.53 billion by 2035, with a CAGR of 6.23%. Growth is driven by increased demand in semiconductors, electric vehicles, solar cells, and construction. Mono/chloro silanes dominate with 68% market share, while functional silanes represent the fastest-growing segment. Asia Pacific leads with 47% market share, followed by North America and Europe.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: The global influenza vaccine market was valued at US$8.96 billion in 2024 and is projected to reach US$13.32 billion by 2030, growing at a 7% CAGR. Market expansion is driven by rising public health awareness, an aging population, government immunization programs, and increased R&D investment. Quadrivalent and inactivated vaccines lead the market, while cell-based technologies and pediatric segments show fastest growth. Key players include GlaxoSmithKline, Pfizer, Sanofi, Moderna, and others.

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+15.9% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +15.9%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (130) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（130）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +3.9 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +3.9 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Investors in Via Transportation (NYSE: VIA) have until August 10, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications in a securities class action lawsuit related to the company's September 2025 IPO. The complaint alleges that the registration statement and prospectus contained materially misleading statements and omitted required disclosures. At the time of the IPO, Via was allegedly adding customers faster than they generated revenue, causing a decline in ARR per customer, and faced regulatory challenges in Germany. Via's stock has declined approximately 70% from its offering price to $14.52.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
